Chromosome ideogram

Source: R/geom-ideogram.R
geom_ideogram.Rd

Draws the cytobands of a single chromosome between y = 0 and y = 1, colored by Giemsa stain with a pinched centromere and an outline. Pair with scale_fill_giemsa() for the standard band colors, annotate_ideogram_window() and annotate_ideogram_zoom() to mark a locus, and theme_ideogram(). See plot_ideogram() for all of these in one call.

Usage

geom_ideogram(chrom, data = NULL, outline_colour = "gray20", linewidth = 0.3)

Arguments

chrom

Chromosome to draw, e.g. "chr3".

data

GRanges object or data frame of cytobands with seqnames, start, end, name, and gieStain columns. Defaults to cytobands_hg38.

outline_colour

Color of the chromosome outline.

linewidth

Width of the chromosome outline.

Value

List of ggplot2 layers

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_ideogram("chr3") +
  annotate_ideogram_window("chr3:187734001-187751500") +
  scale_fill_giemsa() +
  theme_ideogram()
} # }
